_about: Deterministic input corpus for the migration parity baseline. Each case pins the exact pointer path, pressure profile, and tool-setting overrides so the same stroke can be replayed through the current Canvas-2D engine, the future Canvas2DBackend (Phase 2), web Skia (Phase 4), and native Skia (Phase 6). See README.md for the stochastic-tool caveat (pencil/spray/drybrush/inkbrush/textures use unseeded Math.random today).
_status: Inputs authored in Phase 0. Rendered captures (captures/*.png) are pending a run — see README.md.

canvas.note: Coordinates are in the engine's internal 2000x2000 space (Canvas.tsx INTERNAL_SIZE). Origin top-left.

generator.note: How to expand (path, pressureProfile) into the InputPoint[] the engine consumes (see engine.ts InputPoint: {x,y,pressure,hasPressure,t}).
generator.rule: For i in [0..N): f = i/(N-1); (x,y) = path(f); pressure = pressureProfile(f); hasPressure = (pressureProfile != 'none'); t = i * sampleDtMs. Feed sample 0 to engine.begin(), the rest to engine.extend(), then engine.end().
generator.dwellRule: For paths of type 'dwell', after the moving segment, emit `holdSamples` additional samples at the final point with t continuing to increment by sampleDtMs (≈ pointer held still). This exercises StrokeEngine.tick() pooling (watercolor).

none.note: hasPressure=false → engine simulates pressure from stroke speed (derivePressure).

setups._note: Setup strokes are drawn first on the same layer to create the pixels that read-back tools (eraser/smudge/waterdrop) and wet-on-wet (brush blending) operate on. Use a hard, opaque brush.
